The Original formulation is labeled as a 10 mL unit. Its single-unit offer contains one unit, and its 10-pack contains ten units of that same formulation, totaling a nominal 100 mL. These concentrations and volume apply to the Original formulation; they are not assigned to the New Methylcobalamin formulation. The published cyanocobalamin sample report lists identity and other tests but no numeric purity percentage. Both formulations have single-unit offers and matching 10-unit packs.
